document.title: Zookeep Commands
document.purpose: Lightly define the commands supported by zookeep as a control surface for interacting with project repositories and their ecology.
author: Lion Kimbro
ChatGPT

overview.basic: Zookeep exposes a set of commands that act as a control surface over a project repository and its surrounding ecology.
overview.style: Commands are intentionally simple, direct, and composable.
overview.scope: This document describes what commands are, not how they are implemented.

inspect.basic: Inspect the current project and produce a structured report describing its state.
inspect.intent: Understand the repository and its ecology.
notes: Focuses on presence, structure, and basic signals.

clean.intent: Return the repository to a clean state with respect to zookeep.
notes: Primarily removes zookeeper-generated files such as zookeeper-report.json.
Should be safe to run repeatedly.

publish-github.intent: Project the local repository into a remote GitHub repository.
notes: Will instruct the user to run 'zookeep init-git' if not initialized.
Creates a remote repository and pushes code.

init-git.basic: Initialize a git repository for the project.
init-git.intent: Establish local version control for the repository.
notes: Creates a .git directory if not present.
May create .gitignore, LICENSE, and README.md if missing.
Safe to run if repository already exists.

command-character.non-destructive-by-default: Commands should avoid modifying or deleting user data unless explicitly intended (e.g. clean).
command-character.direct: Each command should do one clear thing.
command-character.composable: Commands should be usable independently and in sequence.
command-character.transparent: Effects of commands should be observable (e.g. files created, updated, or removed).

evolution.living-document: This document is expected to evolve as new commands are introduced.
evolution.addition: New commands should be added with a brief description, intent, and a few notes.
evolution.restraint: Avoid over-specifying behavior here; detailed behavior belongs in implementation or separate specs.
